disclosurePage.title: Disclosure
disclosurePage.lead: Some links here pay me. This page says which ones, and what that does not buy.
disclosurePage.body:
## What an affiliate link is

If you buy something after following one, I get a percentage. You pay the
same price you would have paid going direct.

## How you can tell

Every page carrying one shows a banner at the top, above anything you could
click. Every affiliate link carries `rel="sponsored"` in the markup.

Neither is something I remember to do. The banner renders from a database
flag and the attribute is set by the component that draws the link, so a
page with an affiliate link and no banner would take a code change to
produce. That is deliberate: a disclosure that depends on me remembering is
missing exactly on the page where I forgot.

## What it does not buy

A commission does not get a tool onto this site and does not soften what I
say about one.

Every repo entry has a field called **the catch** and a field called **not
for you if**. They sit near the top of the page, before the reasons to use
the thing, because a reader who should walk away deserves to find that out
early rather than at the end. If a tool pays me and its catch is that it
gets expensive once you have real traffic, the page says so.

I do not take payment to remove a caveat. If that ever changes, it will be
written here, with the date.

## Sponsorship

No sponsored posts so far. If one happens it will say so in its first line,
not in a footer and not in a hashtag.

## Anything I got wrong

If a link is marked wrongly, or one is missing a marker, tell me and I will
fix it. My GitHub is [aminsolahuddin](https://github.com/aminsolahuddin).

aboutPage.title: About
aboutPage.lead: I make videos about tooling, and this is where the code from them lives.
aboutPage.body:
I am Amin Solahuddin. I work towards being a technical architect, which in
practice means I spend most of my time on the parts of a system that are hard
to change later.

## What this site is for

Every video I publish has a page here holding the code, the files, the
commands and the notes that did not fit in the runtime. I say the short URL
out loud in the video, and it takes you straight to the page.

There is no email wall in front of any of it. If I promised something in a
video, it is on the page when you arrive.

## The repo library

Tools I have actually run, each with what it is for, who should skip it, and
what the catch is. A job checks them against GitHub every week, so a project
that has been archived says so here rather than sitting under a recommendation
I wrote two years ago.

Nothing gets deleted when it dies. An entry that says *this is over, use X
instead* is usually worth more than the recommendation it replaced.

## Languages

The site is built for English, Bahasa Melayu and 简体中文. Most of the writing
is English so far, and anything untranslated says so at the top of the page
rather than quietly serving you a language you did not ask for. Nothing here
is machine translated.

## Contact

[github.com/aminsolahuddin](https://github.com/aminsolahuddin).

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.lead: What this site stores, which is very little, and how to get rid of it.
privacyPage.body:
This notice covers personal data under Malaysia's Personal Data Protection
Act 2010. It is short because the site collects very little.

## What is stored

**Your language choice.** A cookie named `NEXT_LOCALE`, set when you pick a
language, so the site stops guessing on your next visit. It holds a language
code and nothing else.

**Short-link hits.** When you follow a `/r/` link I record which link it was,
which site sent you, and which language you were served. No IP address, no
cookie, no identifier — the row cannot be tied back to a person, including
by me. It exists so I know which video sent people to which page.

That is the whole list.

## What is not stored

There is no analytics on this site yet. When I add one it will be cookieless
and this page will be updated before it goes live.

There is no newsletter yet, so no email addresses are held. When there is,
signup will be double opt-in — an unticked box you tick yourself, then a
confirmation link you have to follow — and every message will carry a working
unsubscribe link. I will not import a list from anywhere.

There is one login on this site and it is mine. It exists to let me edit
pages, and no visitor account can be created.

## Third parties

The site runs on Vercel and stores content in a Neon database, both of which
necessarily see the requests that reach them. Videos are linked, never
embedded, so YouTube and TikTok do not load anything into this page or see
you until you choose to go there.

## Your rights

Under the PDPA you may ask what personal data I hold about you, ask for it to
be corrected, and ask for it to be deleted.

Given the list above, the honest answer today is that I almost certainly hold
nothing about you. Ask anyway if you want to be sure — I will check and tell
you either way.

## Getting in touch

[github.com/aminsolahuddin](https://github.com/aminsolahuddin).
